item.title: Joseph William Jones - Obituary
item.description: Joseph William Jones, Jr. (Billy) was born Feb. 13, 1945 in Monroeville to Joseph William Jones, Sr. and Jennie Lee Urquhart Jones. He passed away peacefully at his home on Jan. 23 surrounded by his family. Billy attended Murphy High School in Mobile and later Monroe County High School in Monroeville. item.title: Mobile market to return to Georgiana
item.description: UAB Mobile Market returns to Georgiana Jan. 30, giving residents renewed access to fresh food as the town’s permanent grocery stays closed for remodeling.

item.title: Butler County Arrests Jan. 12 - 25
item.description: Butler County releases Jan. 12–25 arrest log, detailing charges ranging from failure to appear and DUI to drug offenses, domestic violence and theft.

item.title: Lions Club meets Greenville High football coach
item.description: New Greenville High head football coach Gary Johnston shares his move from Foley and vision for the Tigers with the Greenville Lions Club.

item.title: To die in the Lord
item.description: Dean Kelly reflects on Revelation 14 and 1 Thessalonians 4, explaining the hope, blessing, and rest promised to patient, obedient Christians who “die in the Lord.”

item.title: You must decide who you are
item.description: Discover why God repeatedly called Ezekiel “son of man,” how his Babylonian exile shaped his visions of judgment and mercy, and what his message means for your faith today.

item.title: Jason Petty brings Hank home to the Ritz
item.description: Jason Petty returned to Greenville’s Ritz Theatre on Jan. 22, blending stories and Hank Williams classics in a “Homecoming” tribute to Butler County’s country music legend.

item.title: Humility Needed in the Pulpit and Pew
item.description: From music disputes to “ego on parade,” pastor Michael J. Brooks uses real church conflicts to show why humility — on the platform and in the pews — is essential to resisting spiritual harm.

item.title: Reaching for Ruth-like faith
item.description: A local pastor reflects on Ruth’s trust in God, his own struggle to match it, and the call to follow God amid uncertainty when the path ahead is unclear.

item.title: Artisans market showcases local talent
item.description: Annual Alabama Artisans Market at Beeland Park pairs with Greenville Camellia Show, featuring handmade goods and Gee’s Bend quilt history from speaker Betty Anderson.
